2120847496016711926.author: deepcoin_news
2120847496016711926.context: Deepcoin News resume noticias de 24h: Coinbase dice que más del 99% de los activos de clientes está en cold storage tras el hackeo de $6.3B a Binance; CZ pide una alianza de seguridad cripto ante ataques con IA tras ese hackeo; Liquid Network restaura el respaldo completo en bitcoin tras un exploit de $320M.
2120847496016711926.suggested_text: "99% in cold storage" is reassuring, but it's still their cold storage and their keys. After a $6.3B breach, the question isn't which exchange stores coins better, it's whether your $BTC needs to sit there at all.
